commit_message: Remove obsolete MMD runtime physics implementation
pr_body:
## Summary

Implements ADR 0112 engine-native Secondary Motion. This follow-up deletes the orphaned pre-cutover `crates/engine/src/mmd_physics.rs` implementation. The file is no longer compiled by the engine module graph and still encoded the removed MMD/Bullet runtime fidelity contract, old rigid-body aliases, MMD-specific gravity, damping, and seek pre-roll behavior.

The current engine-native Secondary Motion implementation remains in `engine-physics` / `engine-rig`. The PR remains Draft through final audit and validation.
